biocontainers.name: rxdock
biocontainers.summary: A fast, versatile, and open-source program for docking ligands to proteins and nucleic acids

biotools.summary:
RxDock is a fast and versatile open-source docking program that can be used
to dock small molecules against proteins and nucleic acids. It is designed for high-throughput virtual screening (HTVS) campaigns and binding mode prediction studies.
